The #MeToo Kavanaugh Ambush

A story this old and unprovable can’t be allowed to delay a Supreme Court confirmation vote.

From the Wall St Journal Editorial Board: https://t.co/3mfomhqdEA

@JRHunTx I am with you when "believe women" is only used in the spirit of and for the cause you mention. I am dismayed when just causes are hijacked for political opportunism, thereby actually hurting the real cause. I believe the Senate last week hurt rather than helped the #MeToo cause.

@JoePerticone This is the key. Sasse is simply saying that when he votes for Kavanaugh, please don't consider it a vote against #MeToo, which should go without saying, but in politics it never does. So say it must, Ben Sasse. That's all.
